method: Agent visual examination of actual decoded JPEG sheets, chronological row-major order; every caption midpoint; 16 timestamp-matched before/after frames. Separate editorial judgment below, not inferred from decode/geometry.

stolonAndPolyps: Stolon first extends horizontally from cyst, followed by upward hydranth growth and branching.
ending: Visible bud near right branch develops into new medusa, then detaches toward opening composition. Colony remains contextual behind it.
phoneScale: Main captions readable in examined360px samples; no sampled subject-caption intersection after filament correction. Small scientific disclosure is subordinate and is not certified for all devices.
creativeLimitations: Stylized layered SVG rather than photorealism or a3D fluid simulation.
